zh.title: 加拿大航空宣佈取消全球十六個長途航點的航班
zh.summary: 加拿大航空取消涵蓋歐洲與亞太等地區的十六個長途目的地航班。
body: 根據航空新聞媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日的報導，加拿大航空公司已決定取消飛往全球十六個長途目的地的航班。這些被取消航班的航點均屬於跨洋航線，此項調整將會對該航空公司在多個國際市場的營運規劃造成直接影響。
報導內容進一步指出，這十六個受到影響的長途航點在地理分佈上相當廣泛，其範圍涵蓋了整個歐洲地區、非洲地區、亞洲太平洋地區以及中東地區。目前，有關這些具體受到波及的長途航線名單與相關細節，仍有待該航空公司公佈與確認。

en.title: Air Canada Cancels Flights To 16 Long-Haul Destinations Globally
en.summary: Air Canada cancels long-haul flights to 16 destinations in Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East.
body: According to a report published by the aviation news website Simple Flying on September 2, 2026, Air Canada has decided to cancel its flights to 16 long-haul destinations. This decision represents a notable operational adjustment to the airline's international flight schedule and its global network.

The affected long-haul destinations are distributed across several key geographical regions, which include Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. Although the complete list of the cancelled international routes has not been fully detailed in the report, these operational adjustments are expected to impact the carrier's scheduled services across these global regions.

zh.title: 西南航空宣布開設首批機場貴賓室
zh.summary: 西南航空擬於2027年底前開設首批四間機場貴賓室
body: 西南航空（Southwest Airlines）於2026年9月2日宣布，計劃於2027年底前在奧斯汀、巴爾的摩、檀香山及納什維爾四座機場開設首批貴賓室。
首批貴賓室位於奧斯汀伯格史壯國際機場（AUS）、巴爾的摩/華盛頓瑟古德·馬歇爾國際機場（BWI）、檀香山丹尼爾·井上國際機場（HNL）及納什維爾國際機場（BNA），興建工程已展開。
西南航空表示，未來數年將在熱門商務及休閒市場額外規劃至少七間貴賓室，但未透露具體地點。貴賓室將與摩根大通（Chase）合作開發，並結合Chase Sapphire Reserve貴賓室網絡的既有特色。
貴賓室的使用資格將與預定於2027年推出的Chase聯名西南航空Rapid Rewards信用卡掛鉤，航空公司尚未公布年費或其他進入方式。

en.title: Southwest Airlines to open first airport lounges in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu and Nashville
en.summary: Southwest plans to open first airport lounges in four cities, with construction started and more locations planned.
body: Southwest Airlines announced on September 2, 2026, plans to open its first airport lounges in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu and Nashville, beginning in late 2027.

The first four lounges are located at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS), Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL) and Nashville International Airport (BNA). Construction has already started on these locations.

The airline said at least seven additional lounges are planned over the following several years, although it did not identify the markets. The lounges are being developed in partnership with Chase and will draw on features from the Chase Sapphire Reserve Lounge Network.

Access will be tied to a new premium Southwest Rapid Rewards credit card from Chase scheduled to launch in 2027. The airline has not yet announced the card's annual fee or other ways to enter the lounges.
